title: Astro Portal session event payload: pointing_help
description: A pointing help ended: `method: manual` — the person aimed with the phone's camera (« Viser avec la caméra ») until the target was centred; `method: mount` — « Aide au pointage » drove the mount (a GoTo, a plate-solving check, an adjustment, again) until the target was centred, the rounds ran out or something ended it. `outcome` says how it ended; `gapDegrees` is the last gap measured by plate solving; `rounds` the adjustments the mount-driven course made. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

outcome.description: `centred` — the target is centred; `failed` — no measure, or the rounds ran out; `refused` — the pointing safety or the mount refused a move; `stopped` — STOP, the background or a slew that never ended; `lost` — the mount's link was lost.

targetId.description: The plan's key of the target the mount was sent to, the same one the target events use (a calibration star or a polar-alignment move carries its own key).

targetLabel.description: The target's display name (« M110 »), for a reader that cannot resolve `targetId`.

gapDegrees.description: Optional: the angular gap, in degrees, between where the device said it pointed and the target, read from the device when it reports a position. Absent means the device said nothing of where it pointed.

turnAskedDegrees.description: Optional: the largest turn, in degrees, the mount-driven course asked the person to confirm during the run (« La monture va tourner de N° : continuer ? » — an automatic adjustment that turns the mount more than 3°). Absent means no question was asked.

sensor.description: Optional, `method: mount`: who measured the course — `phone` this phone's camera, `aimingPhone` the aiming phone on the tube, `camera` the telescope's camera (a guide camera or the main camera, over Alpaca or INDI). Absent in the payloads written before it.

turnAnswer.description: Optional, with `turnAskedDegrees`: the answer to the last question — `continued` the mount turned, `declined` nothing moved (the run ends as `failed`).
